name: VLR-Bench-en
description: A benchmark for English visual–language reasoning: given images paired with text, models must answer questions or select/craft captions requiring compositional and commonsense inference. It evaluates how well vision–language models generalize beyond memorized image–text pairs and handle multi-step visual reasoning.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset for vision–language reasoning with modest but growing adoption in the VL evaluation community.
